title: Real local face runner profile

context.summary: Add a supported local face detection and recognition runner profile.
context.background: Face observations and identity matching already have product surfaces; v0.1.1 needs a real supported local runner and acceptance.

in: Add a real local face runner profile such as InsightFace buffalo_l or CompreFace.
Add Compose service, healthcheck, installer selection, resource hints and diagnostics.
Persist workspace-scoped identities, observations and embeddings from runner output.
Validate auto-match threshold behavior and face identity rename/merge flows.

acceptance_criteria: Installer can select, start and healthcheck the face runner.
Face observations are workspace scoped and auto-matched by threshold.
API, CLI, MCP and UI identity rename/merge flows continue to work.

manual_checks: Run live face acceptance with Docker.
Confirm face search and identity merge keep source refs.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
